answer: Verifying identity through a unique physical device is the mechanism, and each new account requires the device to sign a challenge. The enforcement rule is that a single device can only register one identity, while the per-identity cost remains the hardware purchase and a monthly subscription fee. The process begins at a single vertex where the device is first bound to the account. A secure kernel validates the challenge and enforces the one-device limit, and the total cost is an umber reflecting the hardware and subscription.
